title: asq Office service inventory
description: The body of GET /api/services (backend-v1.4.md §4): the same four service entries capabilities.json carries, probed fresh. It exists separately so a client can re-check availability without re-reading the whole capability document, and so a service going down is one small read rather than a reason to re-negotiate features.

services.description: Exactly the four ids of capabilities.json#/$defs/ServiceId, each once.

checked_at.description: When this inventory was assembled. Individual entries keep their own checked_at, which may be older when a probe was skipped.
